services.title: Vyenkatesh Ashram Old-Age Home
services.shortDesc: A safe, clean, supportive and dignified residential living environment for senior citizens in need.
services.fullDesc: Vyenkatesh Ashram provides seniors with a home of peace, companionship, and respect. Located in the tranquil rural setting of Anjikar Bagh, Mahuli (near Mansar), the ashram offers comfortable living spaces, nutritious vegetarian meals, separate clean restroom facilities, and daily opportunities for social and mental rejuvenation.
benefits: Safe, clean, dignified living environment
Nutritious home-cooked vegetarian meals
Round-the-clock supportive staff and care
Calm rural atmosphere away from city pollution and noise
Spiritual satsang, library and daily recreational activities

services.title: Go-Seva Kendra
services.shortDesc: Compassionate care, shelter and nourishment for indigenous cows promoting rural ecological harmony.
services.fullDesc: At Vyenkatesh Ashram, our Go-Seva Kendra houses indigenous cattle in a clean, hygienic and naturally ventilated shelter. Cow care provides therapeutic connection for the elderly residents, while offering fresh milk and organic compost for our community garden.
benefits: Ethical, loving care for indigenous cows
Nutritious fresh milk for ashram elders
Therapeutic interaction and companionship for seniors
Organic composting for the ashram garden and fruit trees

services.title: Naturopathy & Holistic Wellness
services.shortDesc: Gentle yoga, pranayama, herbal remedies and natural lifestyle practices for senior vitality.
services.fullDesc: We emphasize natural wellness to promote longevity, joint mobility, and mental peace among our residents. Morning sun exposure, gentle breathing exercises, pure herbal teas, and simple lifestyle alignment support physical and emotional balance.
benefits: Daily morning pranayama and gentle stretching
Herbal garden with Tulsi, Neem, and medicinal plants
Fresh air and sunshine therapy in Anjikar Bagh
Relaxation techniques to alleviate anxiety and loneliness

services.title: Rural Education & Student Welfare
services.shortDesc: Promoting education for underprivileged students in rural Vidarbha through study materials and guidance.
services.fullDesc: SBBM Social Foundation actively supports rural child and youth development by organizing book distribution drives, educational seminars, and skill training workshops in Nagpur and surrounding rural tehsils.
benefits: Notebook and study material distribution drives
Mentorship and vocational career guidance for youth
Community library access for students
Support for rural school infrastructure

services.title: Daily Activities & Cultural Rejuvenation
services.shortDesc: Engaging daily routines including bhajan, gardening, indoor games, festival celebrations and walks.
services.fullDesc: A purposeful day keeps the mind active and joyful. Our daily schedule includes morning garden walks, community prayer, newspaper reading, board games (carrom, chess), devotional music, and festive gatherings with visiting families and volunteers.
benefits: Scheduled daily routine encouraging active lifestyle
Celebration of all traditional Indian festivals
Interactive storytelling and intergenerational volunteer visits
Peaceful sitting areas under shaded fruit trees

services.title: Basic Healthcare & Routine Monitoring
services.shortDesc: Vital sign checks, medicine administration assistance, and access to local medical practitioners.
services.fullDesc: We maintain routine health records, organize regular visiting doctor consultations, assist residents with their daily medication schedules, and coordinate with nearby healthcare centers in Parseoni and Nagpur for specialized care.
benefits: Regular blood pressure, sugar, and vital monitoring
Medication administration assistance for all residents
First aid and emergency transport coordination to Nagpur
Periodic specialist health checkup camps on-site

faqs.question: What is the procedure for admission to Vyenkatesh Ashram?
faqs.answer: Admission requires submitting an initial enquiry form or visiting our office. Because we maintain high care standards and limited capacity, accommodation availability, medical suitability, and admission formalities must be confirmed directly with the management (+91 98908 98081). Submitting an online enquiry does not guarantee immediate admission.

faqs.question: Where is Vyenkatesh Ashram located?
faqs.answer: The ashram is located at 434, Anjikar Bagh, Mansar Mahuli Road, Village/Post Mahuli, Tehsil Parseoni, District Nagpur, Maharashtra – 441105. The Foundation Head Office is located at C/o Ashvin V. Anjikar, Anjikar House, Panchpaoli, Timki Chimabai Peth, Nagpur – 440018.

faqs.question: Is SBBM Social Foundation a registered organization?
faqs.answer: Yes, SBBM Social Foundation Society was established in 2015 and is officially registered under the Societies Registration Act (Reg No: 332-15-Nag). It operates Vyenkatesh Ashram as a charitable, non-granted old-age home.

faqs.question: Can families and well-wishers visit the ashram?
faqs.answer: Yes, family visits and community well-wishers are welcomed. Prior notification via telephone (+91 98908 98081) is requested to ensure resident rest hours and daily schedules are respected.

faqs.question: How can I support the ashram through donations or seva?
faqs.answer: You can support us through direct bank transfer, contributing daily provisions (grains, oil, groceries), medicines, blankets, or green fodder for our Go-Seva Kendra cows. Official receipts are issued for all contributions. Contact our office directly for verified bank account details.

faqs.question: How can I become a volunteer or member?
faqs.answer: You can submit an online volunteer or membership application through our website. Our team will contact you to discuss your interests, availability, and verify membership eligibility.
